decisions.reason: As a low-cost complementary care product that moved from a mention to its own page in 2024, it still has option value and shows enough market traction to justify staying.

Although it did not gain stronger website prominence, maintenance oil is a cheap adjacent add-on to the core flooring business, so the firm is likely to keep it while demand remains somewhat uncertain.
Its upgrade to a dedicated page suggests positive resolution of uncertainty, and as a care product for the installed base it is inexpensive to carry and strategically complementary.
The underlay supports the firm’s system offer and likely has ongoing option value as an accessory, even if the lack of stronger web emphasis points to only moderate traction so far.
This underlay foam remains a useful complement to flooring sales and is worth retaining as a modest-cost option, though its limited visibility suggests weaker evidence of standout demand.

A new parquet floor ties up more production, inventory, and sales resources than care accessories, and with no stronger signal of uptake by 2024 the option looks more resolved and less worth carrying.
